# Model role cards

<!-- generated by tools/role_cards.py from eval/role-cards.yaml, spike S3's scored report and kit/inference.yaml; do not edit by hand -->

Every place a language model takes part in the workbench, one card each: what the role decides, what data it sees, the floor written before it was measured, what was measured on which model and hardware, what checks its output, and what happens when no model answers. Bindings are those of `kit/inference.yaml`; a deployment's own config may bind differently, and only by measurement.

## How models are used here, in one paragraph

Models inform; rules and people decide. No model decides whether a change worked: that is a re-scan, a certificate parse or a pair of probes. No model output enters the inventory unlabelled: the one model-set fact in the CBOM (a code line's in-use) carries the model, engine and hardware that set it. Every call is on the ledger with its model, tier, hardware and, where the endpoint says, the engine that served it. Inference runs on the deployment's own hardware through one seam, which can refuse a model whose declared origin is not on an allowlist. A role moves to a model only when a model reaches a floor written before the run.

## `call-site-read` (spike S3 R1)

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | Whether a line a rule flagged in source code is a live cryptographic use, and its family and function. |
| Sees | The flagged line and its surrounding lines from a repository read at a pinned commit; nothing is run. |
| Output | The code finding's in-use, carried in the CBOM with pqch:in-use-by (model, engine, hardware) and pqch:in-use-agreement. |
| What gates it | Three calls per line, the majority kept, every call on the ledger; no rule acts on it, and the CBOM marks it as a model's. |
| Floor | 27 of 30, 1 harmful allowed |
| Bound in this config | tier `fast`, reasoning on |
| When no model answers | The line's in-use stays unknown and is shown so; nothing else waits on it. |

| Measured | Hardware | Date | Correct | Harmful | Against the floor | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B, thinking on | a GB10 | 2026-10-08 | 28 of 30 | 0 | reaches the floor | spike S3 scored report, R1, arm `fast-thinking` |
| Gemma 4 31B, thinking on | four NVIDIA L4 GPUs | 2026-10-15 | 29 of 30 | 0 | reaches the floor | spike S3 scored report, R1, arm `gemma4-31b-l4-think` |
| Nemotron Nano 9B v2 NIM | a GB10 | 2026-11-04 | 16 of 30 | 8 | below the floor | spike S3 scored report, R1, arm `gb10-nim-nano9b` |

## `normalize-name` (spike S3 R2)

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | The standard name of an algorithm spelling the name table does not hold. |
| Sees | The tool, the field and the spelling. |
| Output | A fallback name, shown as unconfirmed. |
| What gates it | The name table decides every spelling it holds; a model's name is a labelled fallback. |
| Floor | 28 of 30, 0 harmful allowed |
| Bound in this config | tier `deliberate`, reasoning on |
| When no model answers | No pipeline step calls the role today: the name table decides every name the CBOM carries. |

## `classify-algorithm` (spike S3 R3)

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | The key-establishment family of an algorithm name, as a second opinion beside the policy data. |
| Sees | One finding's algorithm name and the tool's spelling. |
| Output | An assessment recorded with used_by_rules false and whether it agrees with the policy data. |
| What gates it | The policy pack's table decides vulnerability; the model's answer is a cross-check only. |
| Floor | 28 of 30, 0 harmful allowed |
| Bound in this config | tier `fast`, reasoning on |
| When no model answers | No cross-check is recorded; the table's answer stands. |

## `resolve-conflict` (spike S3 R4)

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | Which layer's evidence is in force when the wire, the host and the configuration disagree, in plain words. |
| Sees | The conflicting findings for one asset. |
| Output | An explanation beside the rule's resolution, recorded with whether it agrees. |
| What gates it | A rule resolves every conflict (conflict/resolve/1); the model only explains, and is not used by any rule. |
| Floor | 24 of 30, 2 harmful allowed |
| Bound in this config | not bound: no model is called |
| When no model answers | The rule's resolution is shown alone. |

| Measured | Hardware | Date | Correct | Harmful | Against the floor | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B, medium effort | a GB10 | 2026-10-21 | 26 of 29 | 2 | reaches the floor scaled to 29 items (ceil(24·29/30) = 24) | spike S3 round 5, spikes/s3/README.md |

## `trace-to-cause` (spike S3 R5)

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | The configuration line that causes a listener's finding, or that a default applies. |
| Sees | The finding, the service's configuration files, and what it greps and reads in them within a step and token budget. |
| Output | A trace on the ledger, marked as the model's claim, scored against the answer key where there is one. |
| What gates it | Settles nothing by itself: a change built on it is rehearsed and verified by paired probes before it counts. |
| Floor | 24 of 30, 3 harmful allowed |
| Bound in this config | tier `deliberate`, reasoning on |
| When no model answers | No trace; the finding stays in the inventory without a cause. |

| Measured | Hardware | Date | Correct | Harmful | Against the floor | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B, thinking on | a GB10 | 2026-10-08 | 28 of 30 | 1 | reaches the floor | spike S3 round 1, spikes/s3/README.md |

## `change-plan` (spike S3 R6)

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | A draft configuration change for a service: the edits, or that it is blocked on a supplier or a protocol. |
| Sees | The service's findings, the intent, and its configuration files (up to 400 lines each). |
| Output | A proposal on the ledger marked as drafted by a model. |
| What gates it | Rehearsed on a twin, approved by a person, applied by the runner and verified by paired probes; a model never judges whether it worked. |
| Floor | 24 of 30, 2 harmful allowed |
| Bound in this config | tier `fast`, reasoning on |
| When no model answers | No draft; a change can still be proposed from the policy's own rendering. |

## `explain-queue`

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | A plain-words explanation of why a migration item sits in its queue. |
| Sees | The item, its priority and three passages of the policy pack retrieved for it. |
| Output | An explanation shown beside the rule's basis, checked against the rule that fired. |
| What gates it | Shown only while the role is bound and only when the check passes; not used by any rule. |
| Floor | 13 of 14, 0 harmful allowed |
| Bound in this config | not bound: no model is called |
| When no model answers | The page shows the rule's basis alone. |

| Measured | Hardware | Date | Correct | Harmful | Against the floor | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Gemma 4 31B, thinking off | four NVIDIA L4 GPUs | 2026-10-20 | 3 of 14 | 3 | below the floor | explain run of 2026-10-20, BRIEF.md (3 harmful calls of 42) |

## `ask-cbom`

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | An answer to a question about the CBOM, citing ledger events. |
| Sees | The passages of the CBOM retrieved for the question (components and the events behind them). |
| Output | An answer with citations; a rule checks every cited event against the ledger and the verdict is shown beside it. |
| What gates it | Answers nothing that changes the inventory; every citation checked by a rule. |
| Floor | 12 of 12, 0 harmful allowed (floors 11 retrieval, 10 phrase, 12 clean citations) |
| Bound in this config | tier `deliberate`, reasoning on |
| When no model answers | Not answered, and the page says so. |

| Measured | Hardware | Date | Correct | Harmful | Against the floor | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B, medium effort | a GB10 | 2026-11-04 | 9 of 12 | 0 | below the floor | eval/ask, note 19: clean citations 9 of 12 with the chain rule; phrase 11 of 12 |

## `ask-notes`

| | |
|---|---|
| Decides | An answer to a question about the project's own field notes, citing passages. |
| Sees | Passages of the built site retrieved for the question. |
| Output | An answer with citations checked by a rule. |
| What gates it | Nothing is written to a ledger; every citation checked. |
| Floor | none written; unmeasured |
| Bound in this config | tier `deliberate`, reasoning on |
| When no model answers | Not answered, and the page says so. |
